params.body:
Pins the gateway to v0.35.0, the release built from the tag on main after control#107: the gateway reads Portal's list of capabilities the owner ended before they expired, and refuses an action under one.

`GATEWAY_SHA` is `control-gateway-linux-amd64` from the release's `SHA256SUMS`, checked against the downloaded binary.

To apply, after the merge: `git pull`, then `deploy/gcp/rehearse.sh upgrade`. The refusal only switches on once the carried configuration has the `revocations` block (elixir#237), carried over with `rehearse.sh config` and a reboot.
params.title: The gateway runs v0.35.0
